name: New Tinkertown
summary: New Tinkertown is the staging ground established by the gnomish exiles outside the surface gates of Gnomeregan in western Dun Morogh. Positioned amid the snowy hills, this fortified encampment serves as the forward base for High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition as they coordinate ongoing rescue efforts and battle to reclaim their irradiated capital.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Snow
sections.body: Following the disastrous fallout that poisoned Gnomeregan and scattered its population, the surviving gnomes found shelter with their dwarven allies in Ironforge. Yet staying entirely underground was never an acceptable end for High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. Built right outside the city gates in Chill Breeze Valley, New Tinkertown serves as the gnomes' primary surface base. It acts as both an intake outpost for survivors rescued from the irradiated depths and a fortified perimeter against trogg incursions and roving Frostmane trolls.

sections.title: Operations on the Surface
sections.body: The settlement bustles with engineering activity and triage logistics. The Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition, or S.A.F.E., maintains their surface headquarters here, processing citizens who manage to evacuate the upper corridors of the techno-city. From this base, gnomish scouts and engineers monitor the surrounding toxic fallout and watch for saboteurs allied with Mekgineer Thermaplugg, striving to secure the valley so that a full-scale retaking of Gnomeregan can eventually succeed.

faq.answer: It is the surface foothold established by the gnomish exiles outside the entrance to Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh. It acts as a base camp for rescue operations and the ongoing effort to liberate their lost capital.
High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque and the gnome leadership direct operations here, supported heavily by the rescue operatives of the Survivor Assistance Facilitation Expedition (S.A.F.E.).

faq.q: Why didn't the gnomes stay in Ironforge?
faq.answer: While the dwarven capital of Ironforge welcomed the refugees with open arms, the gnomes refuse to abandon their homeland. New Tinkertown gives them an active surface staging ground to coordinate strikes and extract survivors from the ruins of Gnomeregan.

The settlement faces immediate threats from troggs boiling out of subterranean fissures, irradiated sludge and fallout blowing from the lower depths, and forces loyal to the treasonous Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

angles.text: For every gnome, this outpost is the front line of the battle to take back your ancestral home and rescue those still trapped in the irradiated ruins.
The camp is a proving ground for emergency decontamination apparatus, mechanized sentries, and field repairs under harsh arctic conditions.
